title: Winey Light Filipino Fruits Halo Halo
description: A kid-friendly Filipino dessert featuring basil and sauteed fruits in a halo halo form, with a hint of wine flavor, making it a unique and delicious treat. This shojin-friendly dish is perfect for those looking for a lighter dessert option.

ingredients.name: Mixed fruits
ingredients.notes: such as jackfruit, coconut, and pineapple

ingredients.name: Wine syrup
ingredients.notes: made from grape juice and sugar

instructions: In a large pan, saute the mixed fruits in a little water over medium heat until they are tender.
Add the chopped basil leaves and sugar to the pan and stir well.
In a separate saucepan, combine the water and wine syrup, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the wine syrup mixture for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the sauteed fruits, wine syrup mixture, and coconut milk, and stir well.
Add the evaporated milk to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
To serve, scoop the mixture into individual bowls and top with crushed ice.
Garnish with additional basil leaves and mixed fruits, if desired.
